messages:
teresa_corp: Hi team — our procurement team will not accept invoices until they issue an official PO. They say we need: 10-digit PO, cost center, vendor code, and a vendor portal upload (W-9 + signed SOW). This is holding up billing for this quarter, can we get this escalated?

anna_support: Thanks for the heads-up. Can you send the customer's legal name and the procurement contact? We can try pro-forma or prepayment but need to confirm with accounting. :thinking:

teresa_corp: Company name is "North Lake Health Inc." Proc contact is emily.j@northlake.com. Their portal is Ariba. They gave vendor code VND-8892 and say PO format must be `PO-YY-#####` (e.g., PO-24-01234). Also asked for VAT ID for EU entities — they flagged our UK subsidiary.

mike_accounting: Short answer: we generally can't finalize revenue recognition without an official PO for enterprise deals. We can issue a pro-forma invoice for their records or accept card/prepay if sales agrees. Pro-forma won't close the ledger. :money_with_wings:

julia_sales: FYI, we have a signed SOW and MSA on file (SOW# NLH-2024-09). Procurement specifically refuses a placeholder PO — they require the official PO number before AP will process payment. They said onboarding in Ariba requires matching legal name and W-9. I can send the W-9 now.

anna_support: Thanks. Two parallel asks: 1) Can sales expedite W-9 + MSA upload to Ariba? 2) Mike — can billing put this invoice on hold with a customer note referencing the expected PO number so it doesn't get auto-sent?

mike_accounting: Yes we can add a "PO pending" hold and a note. But ops: we need an expected PO format or tentative number to link for audit. Otherwise the invoice will be rejected later.

procurement_bot: Automated notice: Vendor onboarding for Ariba typically 3-5 business days after document upload. Missing documents: W-9 (required), Company Registration Statement (optional), Tax ID confirmation (if outside US).

teresa_corp: They said they will not accept a "pro-forma" as formal — AP policy. Their compliance team must issue PO after vendor verification. Is there any fast-track for enterprise customers?

julia_sales: I'll raise a ticket with their procurement lead to request expedited onboarding. Also offering a one-time prepaid charge if legal approves. Will send W-9 + SOW link in 10m. :email:

anna_support: Good. sachin, from an engineering/integration side, any risk with holding invoice? Do we have tooling to tag invoices so they don't auto-bill or trigger reminders?

sachin_engineer: We have a billing flag `hold:po_pending` in the billing service. It prevents sending to the customer and suppresses dunning. To reproduce: 1) POST /billing/invoices/{id}/hold with body `\{ "reason": "po_pending" \}` 2) GET /billing/invoices/{id}` returns status `held`. No side-effects expected.

mike_accounting: Perfect — please add note with expected PO format `PO-24-#####` and link to Ariba vendor code VND-8892. I'll place the invoice on hold until we see the official PO.

teresa_corp: Appreciate the quick action. Procurement said they will issue PO once onboarding completes and vendor code is confirmed — they estimated 2 business days after I upload W-9.

julia_sales: W-9 + SOW uploaded to Ariba and email sent to emily.j. Escalation ticket #NLH-ARIBA-47 opened with procurement lead (cc: emily.j).

anna_support: Action items: 1) Mike to place invoice on hold and add note with expected PO format and vendor code (owner: mike_accounting) 2) Julia to monitor Ariba onboarding and confirm PO when issued (owner: julia_sales) 3) Support to update customer thread and close when PO received (owner: anna_support). Target: 48 hours.

mike_accounting: Hold applied to invoice INV-8721 with note: "Awaiting official PO from North Lake Health (Ariba vendor VND-8892), expected format PO-24-#####. Do not send reminders."

procurement_bot: Reminder scheduled: 48 hours to check vendor onboarding status.

teresa_corp: Thanks everyone. If procurement refuses to issue PO we may need to move to prepaid — I'll update. :thumbsup:

anna_support: Keeping this thread open until we have the PO. Will ping here on any change. :eyes:
